A run gate opens the run iff a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7194280548710566105, the least integer with (K/2^64) * 0.999993 >= 0.39; a closed run fails at cost 1 unit. Finite-scale prototypes provide compatibility evidence (supported, not proved); neither simulator outcomes nor sample confidence intervals are substituted for the attack's production success probability. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification, and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized.
